newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: BMB mandates banks to arrange $30 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: BMB mandates banks to arrange $30 mln loan.

text.p: Bahrain Middle East Bank has mandated the Arab Banking Corporation, The Arab Investment Company and Investment Bank Limited to arrange a $30 million loan facility.

The deal is fully underwritten by the three arrangers which are expected to syndicate the transaction among local, regional and international banks by mid-May, the Arab Investment Company said in a statement.
The loan is expected to be signed in June 1997 for a tenor of three years, it said.
Set up in 1982, BMB is 28.6 percent owned by Burgan Bank of Kuwait. The rest is held by investors in the Gulf.
